title: nullmodem
description:
This repository is research on how agents talk to each other below the level of text, when the harness owns the model, the tokenizer and the machine.

It holds research notes, small experiments on local open-weight models, and measurements against a text baseline.

Directed by Ahraz Arifuddin

Researched and verified by different model families across Gemini, Claude, Grok, OpenAI, and Muse
